name: @buka/dsh-plugin-skills
description: In a sidebar page, lists the skills installed globally for every DSH session, flags the ones the npx skills CLI manages, uninstalls each through the right path, keeps a personal list of skill sources to install later (GitHub repos, any git remote such as https/ssh/git, local absolute paths, or package names), exposes them to other plugins through the ctx.bukaSkills service, and labels each saved repository as an npx skills repository or a Claude Code marketplace, expanding GitHub, git-remote and local sources into a cached skills tree
